description: This file defines a utility class `ProfileVerifierLogger` that logs the status of app's baseline profile compilation using `ProfileVerifier`. It checks whether the profile is already compiled, enqueued for compilation, or neither, and logs the appropriate message.

classes.name: ProfileVerifierLogger
classes.description: A class that logs the app's baseline profile compilation status using ProfileVerifier, providing insights into whether the profile is compiled, enqueued, or absent.

methods.name: operator fun invoke()
methods.description: Launches a coroutine that fetches the profile compilation status asynchronously and logs the corresponding status message.
